verdict.rationale: Pipecat's official CLI ships `pipecat context-hub install`, which registers the Pipecat context hub as an MCP server with your coding agent and builds a local index (pipecat-docs-11, pipecat-docs-38). A keyless runtime probe confirms the context-hub subcommand exists in the official CLI and is built for coding agents (pipecat-probe-rt-1). Missing for 10: documentation of the tools the MCP server exposes; MCP access beyond the docs/examples/API index (e.g., Pipecat Cloud or bot management); independent or hands-on confirmation of an agent actually connecting over MCP.
